name: Marcus Riley
bio:
Marcus Riley is a driven HR Manager with a passion for motorsports. Born and raised in Indianapolis, Indiana, he was immersed in racing culture from a young age, attending the Indy 500 every year with his family. After graduating with a degree in Human Resources, Marcus began his career in the automotive industry, quickly rising through the ranks due to his exceptional organizational skills and ability to connect with employees. He later transitioned to Formula 1, eager to combine his professional expertise with his lifelong love of racing.

At Haas F1 Team, Marcus is responsible for overseeing all aspects of human resources, from recruitment and onboarding to employee relations and performance management. He believes in fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment where every team member feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. Known for his pragmatic approach and ability to navigate complex situations, Marcus is a trusted advisor to both management and staff. His dedication to fairness, coupled with his deep understanding of the unique challenges of the motorsports industry, makes him an invaluable asset to the team.

Marcus distinguishes himself by his unwavering commitment to finding innovative solutions that benefit both the team and its employees. He's particularly focused on developing programs that support work-life balance and promote employee well-being, recognizing that a happy and healthy workforce is a more productive and successful one.
